source_review: Exact reciprocal-affine action splits every crossed model interval; no fixed quadrature.
Continuous first variation includes the positive-part cusp term before deciding descent.
Negative support dot alone is explicitly shown insufficient by an invented control.
Conservative Armijo inequality uses upper trial action and lower old action and directional derivative.
Fixed endpoints, original box and nonzero segments checked; exact rational new polygons saved with native identities.
The new support bound is recomputed after each accepted step; both increase and no convergence flag is promoted.
limitations: Two isolated steps from the same polygon, no outer optimization.
No source/model derivative, inserted-node stationarity or first-arrival certificate.
